# The run before this one, on the SAME session an hour earlier, quoted verbatim out of the
# probe log: the two xterms started the way vm/live-smoke.d/kde.sh used to start them, with
# no `-e`, so Arch's /etc/bash.bashrc rewrote the title `-T fwtwin` set.  It is why the
# 2026-09-11 rig run counted 0 -- and `xdotool search --name fwtwin`, the oracle, printed
# nothing on that same session in the same second.  The lines are comments here because
# they are not JSON (the xids dict is a Python repr); nothing parses them.
#
#     === pgrep xterm
#     971 xterm -T fwtwin
#     972 xterm -T fwtwin
#     === xprop -root _NET_CLIENT_LIST
#     _NET_CLIENT_LIST(WINDOW): window id # 0x1000012, 0xe00012
#     _NET_CLIENT_LIST_STACKING(WINDOW): window id # 0x1000012, 0xe00012
#     === xdotool (the oracle, if it runs here)
#     === wdotool search --name fwtwin
#     === KWin raw window list (the script payload)
#     {"u": "ced83d4e-2135-4195-8cde-4857f3bb5f7f", "t": "test@kde-b6:~", "c": "XTerm", "n": "xterm", "p": 971, "xid": 0, "ix": 1, "x": 718, "y": 368, "w": 484, "h": 344, "ty": 0}
#     {"u": "e67925fb-0f1b-4365-8cfa-047218324760", "t": "test@kde-b6:~", "c": "XTerm", "n": "xterm", "p": 972, "xid": 0, "ix": 2, "x": 758, "y": 391, "w": 484, "h": 344, "ty": 0}
#     xids: {'e67925fb-0f1b-4365-8cfa-047218324760': 14680082, 'ced83d4e-2135-4195-8cde-4857f3bb5f7f': 16777234}
#     xwayland_running: True
#     x_info: (':1', '/run/user/1000/xauth_wQfSRv')
#
# So both runs have the X list in windowList()'s own order (run 1: pid 971 first in both,
# holding 0x1000012; this run: pid 2387 first in both, holding 0x00e00012), and WHICH id
# falls to which process is not stable across two starts of the same pair.
